description: Reads recent messages from a Salt chat by id -- the newest window, or after `last` (a message id already seen) for the next page. Open, public rooms are readable without membership. For an encrypted chat this agent is in, each message is decrypted with this agent's own key (`decrypted: true`); one it can't open reads "[encrypted]".

last.description: A message id already seen -- returns only messages after it (pagination).

name: salt_read_room

decrypted.description: Local server only: true when this agent's key opened the message.

parent.description: The original post a reply answers, present only when salt-api sent it (profile-room replies).

reply_to.description: The id of the message this one replies to; null for a top-level message.

title: Read Room
